title: Lagged Bitcoin native-issuance contraction supply-pressure support for BTC long or cash
thesis: A complete-Sunday 28-day Bitcoin native-issuance sum strictly below the same-weekday 28-day sum ending 364 days earlier may identify a lower structural new-supply state with better subsequent BTC return and path-risk evidence than other weeks.
mechanism: Use only Coin Metrics Community IssTotNtv for BTC, sum the 28 complete UTC days ending Sunday, compare with the 28-day sum ending exactly 364 days earlier, make the state usable Wednesday 00:00 UTC, and evaluate one non-overlapping 168-hour BTC response. No price input, block-count normalization, magnitude threshold, smoothing, alternate lookback, direction inversion or halving-event window is allowed.
economic_rationale: If and only if both Design and Validation establish the preregistered predictive direction, a later matched-capital policy would hold full BTC during lower-issuance weeks and zero-yield cash otherwise. It must improve fee-adjusted Calmar and underwater duration while explicitly charging turnover, lost upside and capital utilization; protocol issuance is not assumed to equal miner selling.
